texts.about_text: {vpnName} is a VPN service based on the XRay 26.30.31+ core with XHTTP transport and the REALITY plugin. VLESS and Shadowsocks protocols, post-quantum ML-KEM-768 encryption, xPadding obfuscation, xmux multiplexing. Speeds up to 1 Gbps. No logs are kept. The central server is in Switzerland, exit nodes are in Switzerland, the Netherlands, and Italy.

1.question: What to do if I paid but the subscription did not appear?
1.answer: Please wait for payment confirmation. Currently, payments are processed manually, so it may take some time.

2.question: How to understand which plan suits me by traffic and number of simultaneous connections?
2.answer: Choose a plan depending on your needs. If you plan to use the VPN on several devices simultaneously, pay attention to the simultaneous connection limit (IP). For active use with a large volume of traffic, it is recommended to choose a plan with unlimited traffic.

3.question: Why didn't the client pull new nodes, ports, keys, or SNI?
3.answer: Try updating the subscription using the corresponding button in the client. If the problem persists, make sure you are using the current subscription link and that you have an internet connection. If the problem is not resolved, contact support describing the problem.

4.question: Can I use one subscription link on several devices?
4.answer: Yes, you can use one subscription link on several devices, but pay attention to the simultaneous connection limit (IP) specified in your plan. If you exceed this limit, new connections will start overriding old ones (the server will reset the traffic of the old connection).

5.question: What to do if the subscription link leaked?
5.answer: If the subscription link has been compromised, it is recommended to immediately contact support to obtain a new link. We can revoke the old link and issue a new one to ensure the security of your connection.

6.question: Can I revoke the old subscription and issue a new one?
6.answer: Yes, you can revoke the old subscription and issue a new one. Contact support for assistance with this.

7.question: Which clients are officially recommended and why?
7.answer: The officially recommended clients are INCY and, as a backup, Happ. INCY is lightweight, convenient to use, and supports all the necessary functions for working with our service. Happ can be used as a backup client if for some reason INCY is not suitable or not working (temporary problems or bugs in a client update), but it is not recommended as the primary one due to rare updates and a "cut-down" XRay core.

8.question: How is INCY different from v2rayN, NekoBox, Shadowrocket, Clash, and sing-box?
8.answer: First of all, I want to draw a line: sing-box and clash are separate cores. Although they technically have backward compatibility with XRay, they do not support all the functions and plugins we use. v2rayN and Shadowrocket are clients that use the XRay core, but they are not recommended because they do not provide the same level of functionality and convenience as INCY. INCY fully supports all our technologies and provides the best experience of using the service.

9.question: How to set up per-app proxying so that banks, government services, and local services work correctly?
9.answer: Our service, unlike others, has long since implemented per-app bypass inside the subscription itself (174 apps falling under "Antifraud 2.0" are bypassed). Nothing additional needs to be configured (except for per-game bypass if you have lower ping without VPN). If you have problems accessing certain apps, contact support describing the situation.

10.question: Why, after enabling VPN, do Russian sites not open, or conversely, foreign sites do not open?
10.answer: This may be related to DNS settings or traffic routing. Make sure you are using the correct DNS servers and that your client is configured for a full tunnel or split-tunnel depending on your needs (not "Proxy" mode). If the problem persists, contact support describing the problem.

11.question: How to enable kill switch and verify that it really blocks leaks?
11.answer: Kill switch can be enabled in the client settings. To check that it really blocks leaks, you can disable the VPN and try to use resources without it. If access is not provided, then kill switch is working correctly.

12.question: Can I keep multiple profiles: work, streaming, torrents, games?
12.answer: Of course! Our configurations are universal. We do not try to limit users or pass off our incompetence as "functionality". We do not have configurations for individual scenarios, because it makes no sense. You can use the same config for any purpose, whether work, streaming, torrents, or games.

13.question: How to determine whether the problem is in the client, OS, provider, or server?
13.answer: For a beginner or layperson, this can be difficult. It is recommended to contact support describing the problem, specifying the client used, OS, network, provider, and region. We will help determine the source of the problem and suggest a solution. If for some reason you do not want to provide any diagnostic data, then please write so to support, we will try to help without it, but it will take longer.

14.question: What do you use as the VPN stack?
14.answer: We use the 3X-UI control panel, the XRay core, VLESS protocols (ML-KEM-768 (random) encryption) and Shadowsocks (chacha20-ietf-poly1305 encryption), XHTTP transport, and the REALITY encryption plugin. But, as you may know, XRay is a flexible thing. We have configured MUX, Sockopt, Sniffing, and much more to ensure the most efficient operation and the most pleasant UX.

15.question: What encryption do you use?
15.answer: It depends on what you mean by that. In general, we use ML-KEM-768 (random) encryption for VLESS and chacha20-ietf-poly1305 for Shadowsocks. Also, for standard configurations, the REALITY masking plugin is used, which provides an additional level of protection and helps bypass DPI, and for bypassing whitelists, a properly configured TLS.

16.question: How does Reality help against DPI and bypassing whitelists?
16.answer: The Reality plugin uses certificates of a third-party resource (specified in the SNI) to mask the connection as if you were connecting to a regular HTTPS website specified in the Target Host. It also has a built-in proxy that will drop unauthorized connections to the Target Host, which significantly complicates both active probing and passive DPI. Overall, Reality allows you to hide the fact of using a VPN and makes its traffic look like regular HTTPS traffic.

17.question: What is XHTTP and why is it needed in transport?
17.answer: The XHTTP transport packs VPN traffic into regular HTTP/HTTPS (encapsulation), which allows it to pass through CDNs. It also separates upload and download into independent channels and protocols, which breaks the heuristics of analyzing symmetric patterns of TLS-in-TLS.

18.question: Can the provider determine that I am using a VPN?
18.answer: Well, theoretically yes, but their brains haven't reached that yet. And technically, they would have to significantly improve the hardware of the TSPU before rolling out such an update (since, as we remember, they died even when blocking Telegram).

19.question: Do you really not keep logs?
19.answer: Yes. The No-Logs policy is strictly observed. It means that we do not keep any connection logs, do not analyze traffic, do not store the history of connected IPs, etc. Logs on the server are completely disabled.

20.question: What data is stored in 3X-UI, the bot, the website, and on the servers?
20.answer: 3X-UI stores only aggregated data about subscriptions and traffic necessary for the operation of the service. The bot and website store data about users, their subscriptions, and payments (only for payment confirmation). The servers do not store connection logs or the history of visited websites.

21.question: Are IPs, connection time, DNS, visited websites, and volume by domains logged?
21.answer: No, we do not keep connection logs, do not store the history of visited websites, and do not track user activity on the network. We collect only aggregated indicators of traffic volume and subscription status for the correct operation of the service.

22.question: How is traffic calculated without storing detailed logs?
22.answer: Traffic is calculated based on aggregated data on data transfer between the client and the server. We do not store detailed logs, so accurate traffic accounting is carried out through metrics that do not contain personal information.

23.question: Can the panel admin or server operator see my real IP and traffic content?
23.answer: No, the panel administrator and server operators cannot see your real IP address or the content of traffic. All data is encrypted and processed in accordance with the privacy policy.

24.question: Where are the panel, database, servers, and exit nodes located?
24.answer: The main panel, databases, website, and bot are located on the main server in Switzerland. Nodes and their panels are located in different countries (see the exact countries in the plans). The main panel also functions as a node.

25.question: What happens if the service is demanded to provide user data?
25.answer: Nothing. We do not store connection logs, the history of visited websites, or other personal information, so there is nothing to present to us. This follows directly from our No-Logs policy.

26.question: How to delete an account?
26.answer: To do this, contact support on Telegram with a request to delete the account. We will coordinate the account deletion and delete all data associated with you.

27.question: Why is the limit by IP connections and not by HWID (as usual)?
27.answer: To limit by HWID, it is necessary to store unique identifiers of user devices that have ever been connected to the subscription, which contradicts the principles of privacy and the No-Logs policy. The IP connection limit is a limit and check here and now, without storing identifiers and analyzing them. It also improves the user experience, since you don't have to unlink devices from the subscription, and the limit is generally fairer.

28.question: What does "new connections override old ones" mean when the limit is exceeded?
28.answer: This means that upon reaching the maximum number of simultaneous connections, new connections will replace old ones to free up space for new ones. For example, if you have a limit of 3 connections and you connect from a fourth device, the oldest connection will be terminated to allow the new connection to be established.

29.question: What happens when traffic is exhausted: blocking, suspension, or throttling?
29.answer: When traffic is exhausted, your subscription will be deleted, part of the trust points will be deducted, and you will have to purchase the subscription again. We are also ready on an individual basis to meet you halfway and, as an exception, add traffic to you until the end of the subscription, but only if you contact us in advance. But remember that support owes you nothing, and it is worth considering such moments in advance so as not to get into an unpleasant situation.

30.question: Are discounts, promo codes, and trust points applied automatically?
30.answer: Yes. Trust points are converted into a discount automatically when placing a subscription - nothing additional needs to be entered.

31.question: How does the trust points system work?
31.answer: The trust points system works on the principle of a cumulative discount for regular customers. More detailed information can be obtained from support.

32.question: What payment methods are available, why are all payments verified manually, and how to speed up the process?
32.answer: Currently, the service offers payment via P2P (card-to-card by card number) and YooMoney (via the YooMoney service by entering card details). All payments are verified manually due to the lack of integration with a payment service (we cannot meet all their requirements, so we had to abandon them). To speed up the payment process, it is recommended to write to support 5–10 minutes after payment as a reminder, since we may not always receive a notification from the bank.

33.question: Can I cancel my subscription and get a refund?
33.answer: Yes. Refunds are made on an individual basis at the discretion of the administration or support in accordance with the service rules and the offer. In case of violation of the service terms, no refund is made. To request a refund, contact support describing the reason.

38.question: Is there an artificial speed limit or fair use?
38.answer: No, we don't do that nonsense. We provide unlimited traffic and do not artificially limit the connection speed.

39.question: Is the service suitable for Netflix, YouTube, Twitch, and 4K?
39.answer: Yes, the service is suitable for use with these platforms. We provide a stable connection and minimal latency. The project owner also constantly watches YouTube and Twitch.

40.question: Are torrents allowed?
40.answer: Yes, torrents are allowed. The owner also uses them.

41.question: Can I play online without critical lag, and will VPN affect anti-cheats?
41.answer: You can certainly play, but it all depends on the geographical location of the server. Some anti-cheat and anti-bot systems may react badly to IP changes, IP country changes, or even check ASN. Such risks exist in all services, including games. It is recommended to check services and games for compatibility with certain servers and VPNs. Such problems occur not only with us but also with other VPNs, only others lie to you saying they are ideal for games, and we speak factually.

42.question: Is it safe to use VPN for banks, crypto exchanges, and 2FA?
42.answer: Yes. Our VPN is more than suitable for this. But be careful with banks - all Russian banks and other government apps under the "Antifraud 2.0" program may block VPN, so it is recommended to use per-app bypass, which is already built into the subscription and not change its configuration.

43.question: Do you block access to any websites?
43.answer: No. We don't do that nonsense. We provide access to all websites and services without restrictions. This is our philosophy - internet freedom. We do not engage in censorship and do not restrict access to any resources.

44.question: Are incident notifications sent, and what happens after they are resolved?
44.answer: Yes, we try to promptly notify users of any incidents via the Telegram bot and channel. After the incident is resolved, we also inform users about the restoration of the service and provide details about the causes and measures taken. We also issue compensation in the form of subscription days for downtime to all active users.

45.question: What logs or diagnostics can be sent to support without risking privacy?
45.answer: In fact, nothing. We have everything we need, and we can request from you whatever we may need. In practice, you can share anything. It won't leak beyond support, and support itself won't use it against you.

46.question: How quickly does support respond, and is there escalation to an engineer?
46.answer: Support usually responds almost instantly (within 5 minutes), sometimes it may take longer, but overall we try to respond as quickly as possible. Escalation is not required, since support, the developer, the project owner, and the administration are one and the same person.

47.question: Is there a status page, an incident channel, or a public changelog?
47.answer: The status page of the internal infrastructure is the main page of the website. All news (including changes and incident information) is published in the Telegram channel.

48.question: Who is behind the project? Is it a company or private individuals?
48.answer: It's one person, an individual, an ordinary enthusiast who wants to make a convenient, fast, private, and overall best-in-all-aspects VPN service for themselves and other people. The project is open-source and all source code is under the MIT license, so anyone can check the code, configs, and scripts if they ask support to send them.

49.question: Why trust a service made by one person rather than a large company?
49.answer: Large companies, like any other services, in 99.99% of cases try to extract maximum profit from the user. We make a service for people, not for money. Profit is not important to us, quality is, so the owner is ready to invest in the service even though it is unprofitable.

50.question: Why are you the best in the industry?
50.answer: It would take a hell of a lot to write out here. For this question, it's better to contact support, where they will tell you everything in detail.

51.question: Are the source code, configs, or scripts open, and can they be checked?
51.answer: Yes. To obtain the source code, configs, scripts, and everything else, contact support.

52.question: Where should I write if I suspect account compromise, subscription leak, or fraud?
52.answer: To support, obviously. Describe the situation in detail and we will help you.
